paymentNotice: Payment takes place on Kashier's hosted TEST page. Never enter a real card. Your cart is checked again before payment.
emailRequired: Enter an email address so we can send your receipt.
guestPrint: A printed receipt is requested for guests. Printing is simulated in this prototype.
printStub: Printing is simulated. No physical receipt was printed.
receiptNotice: Your receipt is emailed and saved in your account when signed in.
empty: Your cart is empty. Browse medicines before checking out.
unavailable: This operation is unavailable. Check the connection and refresh.
paymentUnavailable: Test checkout could not be opened. The payment service or return URL may not be configured correctly. Check Order history or contact the project team before paying again.
conflict: The cart or order changed. Refresh and review it before trying again.
uncertain: The result could not be confirmed. Refresh the order before taking another action. Do not pay twice.
savedCard: To pay while signed in at a Terminal, first make a purchase in H.A.V.E Hub and save your test payment method there. You can also start over and shop as a guest.
collectionWindowEnded: The collection window has ended. Refresh to check the confirmed order status.
refundConfirmed: The payment provider confirmed the refund.
refundProcessing: The refund is still being checked. It is not confirmed yet; do not pay again.
refundFailed: The refund needs review. Contact the project team; do not pay again.
receiptPending: The receipt will appear after the order completes.
simulation: Prototype: payment and dispensing use test/simulated services.
cancelBody: This stops collection. Any confirmed payment will follow the order's refund process.
reorderBody: Add the order's products to this Terminal session. Any current cart will be replaced; current prices, stock and limits apply.
collectNotice: Collection is available only at the Terminal assigned to this paid Hub order.
resultNotice: Only the backend confirms payment. Returning from the payment page alone does not mean payment succeeded.
privateResult: This private result is unavailable or has expired. Check your receipt email or sign in again to view order history.
privacy: This result clears automatically for privacy. It does not restore your previous sign-in.

statuses.REVIEW_REQUIRED: Review required — do not pay again

cartNotice: Stock is checked again at checkout. No added tax.
